text:
kevin: deploy-bot reported a mini-canary anomaly in eu-west-1 during post-deploy synthetic checks — sample-replay probe failing intermittently (~35% of samples).

deploy-bot: canary-mini group alpha -> sample-replay: FAIL (p95 210ms, error-rate 4.8%)

emma: noticed similar in a staging run earlier. log traces point to repeated KV_PREFILL calls while serving q8-narrow variant. looks like prefill thrash under burst.

kevin: is production traffic affected?

sre-oncall: prod remains on stable routing. only the canary pool is seeing failures. metrics show CPU spikes + short GC pauses coincident with the probe failures.

emma: repro suggestion: run small local replay with low ratio to hit canary and reproduce memory/GChits.

emma: example command:
```
./replay --target https://canary-eu-west1.int --ratio 0.015 --seed 7
```

emma: replay trace: repeated `KV_PREFILL` + `model_variant=q8-narrow` and memory climbs then brief GC which correlates with 5xx spikes.

kevin: proposed mitigations: 1) flip kv prefill off for q8 on canary (feature flag), 2) rollback canary, 3) pin traffic back to stable pool. Preference?

sre-oncall: prefer surgical feature-flag flip (1). Lower blast radius, quick to apply via infra-api, gives time for proper fix.

emma: i'll submit the flag change scoped to canary: `kv.prefill.q8=false` and run a focused 10k request replay to validate.

kevin: do it. if healthy, hold rollout for observation window.

deploy-bot: change queued: cfg-change/6153004321-kv-prefill-q8 by emma (scope: canary-eu-west-1)

emma: quick validation replay done: p95 ~110ms, errors ~0.4% now. streaming logs for next 20m. :thumbsup:

kevin: placing rollout on 30m hold. @sre-oncall add temporary alerts: p95 > 180ms OR errors >1% => auto-rollback.

sre-oncall: alerts configured, dashboards pinned. will escalate if thresholds breach.

kevin: i'll add note to release changelog: "6153004321 - canary hold: kv.prefill toggle applied for q8 variant; monitoring". any concerns resuming after 30m if stable?

emma: no concerns. opening follow-up ticket to implement q8 memory-safety improvements and to revert the flag once fixed.

kevin: thanks. filing RN-6153 and follow-up ticket INF-2981. will page infra rotation if alert triggers.

sre-oncall: ack, monitoring active.

(reacts: :eyes: kevin, :white_check_mark: emma)
